## 1. Navigation Patterns

| Pattern | Description | Best For |
|---|---|---|
| **Bottom Tab Bar** | Fixed horizontal nav at bottom with 3–5 items | Primary app sections |
| **Top App Bar** | Title + back button + actions | Stack navigation |
| **Stack Navigation** | Push/pop screens with back gesture | Hierarchical flows |
| **Tab Navigation** | Multiple root tabs with shared content | Distinct modules |
| **Segmented Control** | Switch between modes/views | Filters, time ranges |
| **Bottom Sheet** | Slide-up panel from bottom | Quick actions, filters |
| **Modal/Full-screen** | Blocks current screen | Checkout, auth |
| **Drawer/Side Menu** | Slide-in from side | Settings, secondary nav |
| **Floating Action Button (FAB)** | Circular button for primary action | Create/Compose |
| **Swipe Navigation** | Swipe left/right to change | Carousels, galleries |
| **Bottom Navigation (iOS-style)** | Labeled tabs with icons | iOS apps |
| **Navigation Bar (Android)** | Top bar with back/title/overflow | Android apps |
